name: io.github.nubiia-dev/mcp-vidsigner
description: Unofficial MCP server for the VIDsigner API: e-signature, e-delivery and management (81 tools)

environmentVariables.name: VIDSIGNER_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name of your VIDsigner subscription (Basic auth for reads and JWT user).

environmentVariables.name: VIDSIGNER_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID issued by Validated ID. Required for write operations (JWT).

environmentVariables.name: VIDSIGNER_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret issued by Validated ID. Required for write operations (JWT).

environmentVariables.name: VIDSIGNER_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Environment: pre (pre-production, default) or pro (production, read-only unless enabled).
